That would reduce the surface for coordinator-driven loads (A-004, TB-002 and the model-weight/availability threats) and adds no trust grant. Whether the Swift provider enforces the filter as documented, and whether the anchor exists, cannot be verified here. This is an unverified contract, not a regression.

I identified no invalidated assumptions, no new attack surface, and no needed threat-model update from the visible evidence.
